results.title: Почтальон победы
results.overview: Great Patriotic War. 18-year-old field postman Azamat delivers valuable cargo to the front line every day. He knows all the secret paths in the forest and in the swamp, dreams of the feat and love of the field doctor Masha. When a military plane on a secret mission crashes in the forests, Azamat alone knows how to get to the target the fastest and sneak a reconnaissance group there unnoticed.

results.title: GCW: Joey Janela's Spring Break X
results.original_title: GCW: Joey Janela's Spring Break X
results.overview: Joey Janela's Spring Break X was a professional wrestling event promoted by Game Changer Wrestling and produced by Joey Janela that took place on April 17, 2026 at the Horseshoe Las Vegas in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA.

results.title: Arne Goes to Space
results.overview: Two small-town brothers are visited by an alien. Having crash-landed in the forests of Norrbotten, the visitor is named Roland. The brothers, Arne and Stefan, teach him everything important about life on Earth, including moonshine, hunting, and the mystery of love.

results.title: Weightless
results.overview: Fifteen-year-old Lea is spending her summer at a health camp tucked between the forest and the sea. Her new roommate, Sasha, is everything Lea wishes she could be: bold, magnetic, and unafraid to take up space in the world. While Sasha flirts with the local boys, Lea’s gaze is fixed on Rune, the camp’s charming instructor. When Rune reciprocates her attention, something awakens within Lea; an unfamiliar yet thrilling desire.

results.title: 씨발 (SHIBAL)
results.overview: A series of mishaps befalls Tom, a printmaker with a single task: delivering a plaque to a Korean restaurant.

results.title: Bogatyrs
results.overview: Ancient Rus. The hero Svyatogor defeated the evil Sorcerer who wanted to conquer Rus - to do this, he used magic to turn into a Dragon. Svyatogor hid three artifacts (the claw, eye, and vein of the Dragon) in the modern world so that evil would never return. But because of the schoolboy Vanya, the Sorcerer's beloved enters our time. She wants to find these artifacts, resurrect the Dragon, and bring her betrothed back to life. Together with two heroes from ancient Rus, Vanya must find the villain and prevent her from carrying out her plan.

results.title: Pour the Water as I Leave
results.original_title: Pour the Water as I Leave
results.overview: A surreal exploration of the war in Bosnia told through the unbreakable spirit of seven of her people whose strength to leave was as powerful as the fight to stay. Through the lens of diaspora, the film captures not just the weight of displacement, but the defiant act of survival and the unwavering pursuit of home, no matter where the journey leads.

results.title: Boat Movie
results.overview: A group of friends go on a boat outing to witness an unprecedented natural phenomenon.  Maggie joins a new group of friends (Steph, Steven, Anna, and James) for a boat day. After they are left on an isolated beach, Maggie learns that today is the day that the sun is predicted change color. Maggies tries to hide her nerves about this unprecedented solar event while also managing her social anxiety around a new group. When the sun is about to change color, Steven reveals that there is a 10% chance of mortality. Maggie has a panic attack and faints; the rest of the group goes haywire. Suddenly, a beautiful pink hue is cast upon the group. Everything is fine. Maggie wakes up to find her new friends dead. She freaks out, then realizes it's just an awful prank. What a perfect day!

results.title: Mascott
results.overview: In the absurd world of film and TV, Scott, a trans actor yearns for more than a stand-in career. When they land the lead role of Barry the Bear, the sudden fame and gender perceptions of this aggressive character take them for a ride.

results.title: Secret Sins
results.overview: After the death of his father, a pastor's son takes the lead, but a power-hungry deacon plots his ruin in a tale of faith, ambition, and betrayal.

results.title: Verse
results.overview: Seventeen year-old Adam is forced to confront where his virtual persona ends and his real self begins when he decides to finally meet his VR girlfriend in real life.

results.title: Life at Sandy's
results.overview: A lonely American stuck in a small Norwegian town is lured in by the characters of a friendly sitcom with increasingly sinister intentions.

results.overview: Remake and update on Au Yeung Ping Keung’s murder mystery after his death

results.title: The Watergate Caper: Richard Nixon and the Death of the American Dream
results.original_title: The Watergate Caper: Richard Nixon and the Death of the American Dream
results.overview: The Watergate Caper is an archival documentary, narrated by Harry Shearer (This is Spinal Tap), tracing the rise and fall of Nixon from the presidential primaries of 1968 through the Watergate break-in of June 1972 to his resignation two years later, killing trust in the political process and the American presidency in the wake of the Vietnam War.  The film draws on hundreds of hours of TV news taped off-air by the Nixon White House to tell the untold story of the Watergate burglars. How did tapping the wrong phone with a bug that didn't work lead to their arrests and Nixon's resignation?  It also explores representations of the Nixon years in popular culture, using the music, commercials, and cinema of the era to evoke a fevered political landscape of culture wars, dirty tricks, paranoia and assassination.

results.title: Tethered
results.overview: Ayden, a man grappling with a fractured conscience, finds himself at the mercy of a methodical psychiatrist who pushes his unorthodox tactics to the extreme.

results.title: Seducing My Hockey Rival
results.overview: Connor loses everything when his curling team disbands. His girlfriend, Ivy, dumps him. She leaves him for Hunter Strand. Hunter is a billionaire hockey captain. Connor blames Hunter for his ruin. He devises a revenge scheme. He joins Hunter's hockey world. Connor plans to seduce Hunter. This will sabotage the engagement. Connor insists he is straight. His clumsy seduction attempts create intense tension. Soon, fake attraction becomes real love. Ivy discovers the original plot. She successfully breaks them apart. Connor makes a dramatic confession. Hunter forgives him. They reconcile and choose love over societal expectations.

results.title: Killer Thong
results.overview: Two low-budget dancers, Cashier and Old-Timer, reunite to perform a surprise birthday gram for Alex, a closet lesbian who is so grossed out by their crude performances that she has a nightmare of her girlfriends being stalked and killed by Cashier's supernatural KILLER THONG. As the only survivor, she must confront her fears, find a way to defeat the KILLER THONG and admit her attraction to women.

results.title: A Prince in Paradise: A Royal Wedding
results.original_title: A Prince in Paradise: A Royal Wedding
results.overview: When the fairy tale royal wedding of Olivia Perkins and Prince Alexander is derailed by an archaic law, the couple must confront an uncertain future and fight for their right to be together.

results.title: Vanishing Point
results.overview: Three urban explorers enter an abandoned office building in search of forgotten spaces, but as the layout shifts and reality frays, they find themselves trapped in a 'liminal' maze that quietly erases their sense of time, place and each other.
